questions.stem: Which noun names the act of seeing the puppy?
questions.listenScript: The door opens and Lin sees the puppy she missed all week. Her face immediately brightens, and she smiles before the puppy even reaches her.

questions.explanation: Sight is the noun for seeing; the puppy's appearance makes Lin smile.
questions.parentExplanation: 看见小狗这件事对应名词sight，不是引言、世纪或事实档案。

passages.text: During my first week at junior high school, I struggle to choose an activity. After sitting in lessons, I am still full of energy and want to move. Older pupils invite me to try table tennis during the lunch break. I cannot control the ball well, so one pupil shows me a slower practice. We pass the ball gently across the table instead of playing a match. By Friday, I can keep the ball moving for several turns. I put the club time on my timetable and look forward to the next week.

parallelText.en: During my first week at junior high school, I struggle to choose an activity.
parallelText.zh: 升入初中的第一周，我一直难以选定一项活动。

parallelText.en: After sitting in lessons, I am still full of energy and want to move.
parallelText.zh: 上课坐了一段时间后，我仍充满活力，想动一动。

parallelText.en: Older pupils invite me to try table tennis during the lunch break.
parallelText.zh: 高年级学生邀请我午休时试试乒乓球。

parallelText.en: I cannot control the ball well, so one pupil shows me a slower practice.
parallelText.zh: 我控制不好球，于是一位学生教我一种慢些的练习。

parallelText.en: We pass the ball gently across the table instead of playing a match.
parallelText.zh: 我们轻轻把球打过球台，不是正式比赛。

parallelText.en: By Friday, I can keep the ball moving for several turns.
parallelText.zh: 到了星期五，我已经能连续接打几回。

parallelText.en: I put the club time on my timetable and look forward to the next week.
parallelText.zh: 我把社团时间记在课表上，期待下一周。

wordHelp.meaning: a game played with a small ball on a table

passages.text: My brother is good at cooking, but I know only how to make toast. On Saturday, I ask him to teach me one easy meal. He chooses vegetable rice and lets me wash the vegetables while he cuts them. While the rice cooks, he explains each step and answers my questions. After we eat, I offer to do the dishes to thank him for teaching me. He wipes the table, and together we leave the kitchen tidy. I write the steps in a notebook so I can try the meal again.

parallelText.en: My brother is good at cooking, but I know only how to make toast.
parallelText.zh: 我哥哥擅长做饭，而我只会烤面包。

parallelText.en: On Saturday, I ask him to teach me one easy meal.
parallelText.zh: 星期六，我请他教我做一道简单的饭。

parallelText.en: He chooses vegetable rice and lets me wash the vegetables while he cuts them.
parallelText.zh: 他选了蔬菜饭，让我洗菜，他来切。

parallelText.en: While the rice cooks, he explains each step and answers my questions.
parallelText.zh: 煮饭时，他解释每个步骤，回答我的问题。

parallelText.en: After we eat, I offer to do the dishes to thank him for teaching me.
parallelText.zh: 吃完饭，我主动洗碗，感谢他教我。

parallelText.en: He wipes the table, and together we leave the kitchen tidy.
parallelText.zh: 他擦桌子，我们一起把厨房收拾整洁。

parallelText.en: I write the steps in a notebook so I can try the meal again.
parallelText.zh: 我把步骤记在笔记本里，以后就能再试着做。
